publisher: Municipality of Princeton (Princeton Zoning Viewer source layer, GIS account of Ian Henderson / PrincetonNJ)
notes: Layer Zoning_Authoritative (67 base district polygons) in the municipality of Princeton account, the source of the Princeton Zoning Viewer on princetonnj.gov; the service folder name says 2026 draft, but its layer is labelled authoritative and links to adopted ordinances. Zone values have trailing CR/LF in places; trim them. ZONING_CAT is a category (e.g. AFFORDABLE HOUSING), not a district name. Covers Princeton municipality only.
